notes: Hand-authored, not derived. Rule: the file that both declares the per-action allowances and decides whether one more attempt is permitted. src/lib/rate-limit.ts holds RATE_LIMIT_BUCKETS (the per-action capacity/refill table), configFor() (which scales it by the org's plan) and consumeRateLimit() (which spends a token and returns allowed/false) — declaration and decision are the same file, which is why the key is one file. EXCLUDED: src/actions/auth/login.ts, src/actions/auth/reset-password.ts, src/actions/comments/create-comment.ts, src/actions/members/invite-member.ts and the services that call consumeRateLimit — every one of them only reacts to a verdict it did not compute; src/actions/_lib/action-errors.ts (RateLimitedError only names the refusal); src/config/plan-limits.ts (supplies apiRequestsPerHour but owns no attempt counting).
